reason: A local Markdown memory plugin that retrieves relevant notes, injects them into model context, provides memory search and save tools, and captures session turns into a daily chronicle.

summaries.zh: 通过本地 Markdown 知识库检索、注入和保存长期记忆，并自动记录会话内容。
summaries.en: A local Markdown memory plugin that retrieves and injects relevant notes, supports model-driven memory search and saving, and captures session activity.

capabilities: Reads and searches a local Markdown vault
Writes session captures and durable notes to local Markdown files
Injects retrieved wiki context into model requests
Provides memory_search and memory_save tools to the model
Maintains an in-memory LRU and TTL retrieval cache
